source.description:
Operator direction 2026-08-14 (robot identities dispatch; Jira ISSUE-87 is portfolio surface only). Robot identities are XTRM product identities, never Mercury robot accounts. Hard web constraint: all web agents share exactly ONE connected GitHub account and ONE connected Jira account, so the external principal identifies the web plane while logical actor + execution provenance stay separate and machine-readable.

Slice scope (contracts + validation + projection rendering + tests, NO credentials/accounts/connectors):
A. Contracts: xtrm.principal-set.v1 (per-platform bindings), xtrm.actor.v1 (logical actor independent of model/session/account, many-actors-to-one-principal cardinality), xtrm.execution-identity.v1 (attempt/assignment/participant/parent lineage/authority ref), xtrm.provenance.v1 envelope (authorship_mode closed enum incl legacy_unattributed, optional signature honestly classified).
B. Trusted runtime context: actor/execution/assignment/authority resolved from trusted context structurally, caller/prompt override rejected (strict schemas + host-injected fields pattern per channel-comm author lane).
C. Projection: compact visible attribution line + JSON rendering + GitHub commit trailers + Jira comment body/property shapes; content hash + returned external object ref binding.
D. Validation: actor->principal-set authorization, assignment version + authority check, content-hash binding, fail-closed mismatch, uncertain side effects never blindly retried, no secret material.
E. Tests: two actors share xtrm-web; payload-edit impersonation fails; human_direct != xtrm_web_direct; retry changes attempt not participant; tamper fails; legacy stays unknown; Mercury appears only in fixtures.

Non-goals: no account/App/token creation, no connector cutover, no daemon/scheduler, no new DB, no hard-coded Mercury IDs in generic code, no crypto non-repudiation claims, no GATE-AUTH/Substrate/Channels scope absorption. Reuses existing contract family conventions (zod strict, canonicalJson, host-injected identity).
source.notes: Review-fix wave committed b403c91 and pushed; PR xtrm-dev/xtrm#99 opened (base main @ 9abd233). All 3 majors + minors from identity-slice-reviewer addressed: M1 signature covered by envelope hash; M2 explicit never-upgrade attribution classification in projections; M3 seal/bind verify prior integrity + strict-parse (no laundering path); m1 cutoverComplete binding enforcement; m2 legacy mode rejected at assembly; m3 extended secret patterns; receipt entropy 64-bit. Tests 34/34. Re-verification requested from reviewer; bead stays open until review PASS + PR merge.
